dtech-aidlc 1.0.0

Usage: dtech-aidlc <command> [options]

Commands:
  help, --help            Show help
  version, --version      Show version
  onboard [--harness NAME] [--scope NAME] [--docs PATH] [--no-detect]
                          Initialize and detect the project in one command (--harness is required the first time)
  onboard --rescan [--docs PATH]...
                          Re-scan an initialized project and report documentation changes
  init [--harness NAME] [--scope NAME]    Alias of onboard (--harness is required the first time)
  scope [NAME] [--depth NAME]  List scopes or show stages in a scope
  status [--intent ID]    Show current intent and stage progress
  doctor                  Validate graph, state, config, and projection
  orchestrate next [--intent TEXT] [--description TEXT] [--intent-file PATH|-] [--scope NAME] [--depth NAME] [--mode ai|human] [--approved-by NAME] [--detail TEXT] [--force-resume]
                          Use --intent-file to avoid shell quoting; - reads standard input
                          --force-resume --detail TEXT selects a stage whose prerequisite check still fails (owner only)
  orchestrate report --result complete|blocked|skipped [--approval approved] [--approved-by NAME] [--approval-note TEXT] [--detail TEXT] [--stage ID] [--needs NAME]...
                          --needs names a declared prerequisite; the stage resumes once its check passes
  ids check [--stage ID]   List cited identifiers that are not in the intent's ID registry
  config agents            List effective agent models
  config scope [NAME]     Show or set the default scope for new intents
  config mode [ai|human]   Show or set the default orchestration mode for new intents
  config gate-mode [GATE] [human|default]  Pin a gate to human approval, or list pinned gates
  config prerequisite [set NAME --check CMD [--hint TEXT] [--applies-to STAGE]...|remove NAME|check [NAME]]
                          Declare, remove, run or list named environment prerequisites
  config agents set <agent-id> <opus|sonnet|haiku|fable> (claude harness)
  config agents reset <agent-id>
  repos add <name> <url> [--ref REF]
  repos list              List registered dependency repositories
  repos pull [name] [--file FILE]       Clone or fast-forward repositories from aidlc.deps.json
  repos remove <name>     Unregister only; preserve checkout
  completion zsh          Print the zsh completion function
  deps add <id> <dependency-id>
  deps list                List dependency edges
  deps pull <id>           Show direct dependencies and their status
  intent list             List every intent with its status; paused means: not the active intent of this checkout
  intent pause [--detail TEXT]
  intent resume <id>
  intent abandon [<id>] --detail TEXT
  intent depth NAME --approved-by NAME --detail TEXT
  intent rework --detail TEXT  Return blocked Develop work to implementation-design
  intent assign NAME     Assign the active intent
  knowledge init          Create PROJECT.md and .aidlc/knowledge/ if missing
  knowledge sources [--kind KIND] [--description TEXT]
                          List, add, or remove knowledge sources
  knowledge list          List knowledge records
  knowledge show <id>     Show one knowledge record
  knowledge check         Validate knowledge records
  knowledge index         Write .aidlc/knowledge/_index.md
  harness add NAME        Project another harness into this project
  harness status          Show the state of the projected skill files
  harness refresh [NAME] [--dry-run] [--force]  Update projected skill files to this engine version
Global option: --project DIR  Use DIR as the project root instead of the current directory.

Scope values: solo, team, enterprise. Harness values: claude, deepseek.
Phase gates require explicit --approval approved when reporting a phase's final stage.
All workflow state and audit records are local under .aidlc/.

completion zsh.stdout:
#compdef dtech-aidlc

_dtech-aidlc() {
  local -a scopes harnesses models modes agents results
  scopes=(solo team enterprise)
  harnesses=(claude deepseek)
  models=(opus sonnet haiku fable)
  modes=(human ai)
  agents=(
    brief-analyst context-risk-analyst
    solution-explorer decision-facilitator
    implementation-planner builder-verifier
    release-coordinator operations-handoff
    outcome-curator knowledge-steward
    record-keeper knowledge-archivist
  )
  results=(complete blocked skipped)

  _arguments -C \
    '--project[Project directory]:directory:_directories' \
    '--help[Show help]' \
    '--version[Show version]' \
    '1:command:->command' \
    '*::arg:->args'

  case $state in
    command)
      local -a commands
      commands=(
        'help:Show help'
        'version:Show version'
        'onboard:Initialize and detect the project'
        'init:Alias of onboard'
        'scope:Show stages in a scope'
        'status:Show the active intent'
        'doctor:Validate project setup'
        'orchestrate:Advance or report a stage'
        'config:Configure agent models, default scope, mode, gate modes or prerequisites'
        'ids:Check cited identifiers against the ID registry'
        'repos:Manage dependency repositories'
        'deps:Manage workflow dependency edges'
        'intent:List, pause, resume, or abandon intents'
        'knowledge:Manage project knowledge and sources'
        'harness:Inspect and refresh projected skill files'
        'completion:Print shell completion'
      )
      _describe 'command' commands
      ;;
    args)
      case ${words[1]} in
        init|onboard)
          _arguments \
            '--harness[Coding harness]:harness:(claude deepseek)' \
            '--scope[Workflow scope]:scope:(solo team enterprise)' \
            '--rescan[Re-scan an initialized project]' \
            '--docs[Documentation path]:path:_files' \
            '--no-detect[Skip automatic documentation detection]'
          ;;
        scope)
          _arguments '--depth[Depth]:depth:(full standard fast)' '1:scope:(solo team enterprise)'
          ;;
        status)
          _arguments '--intent[Intent id]:intent:'
          ;;
        knowledge)
          _arguments -C '1:action:(init sources list show check index)' '*::arg:->knowledgerest'
          case $state in
            knowledgerest)
              case ${words[1]} in
                sources) _arguments '1:sub:(list add remove)' '--kind[Source kind]:kind:(project docs requirements architecture adr api-spec runbook conventions readme)' '--description[Description]:description:' '2:id:' '3:path:' ;;
                show) _arguments '1:id:' ;;
              esac
              ;;
          esac
          ;;
        intent)
          _arguments -C '1:action:(list pause resume abandon depth assign)' '*::arg:->intentrest'
          case $state in
            intentrest)
              case ${words[1]} in
                pause) _arguments '--detail[Reason]:detail:' ;;
                resume) _arguments '1:id:' ;;
                abandon) _arguments '--detail[Reason]:detail:' '1:id:' ;;
                depth) _arguments '--approved-by[Approver]:name:' '--detail[Reason]:detail:' '1:depth:(full standard fast)' ;;
                assign) _arguments '1:name:' ;;
              esac
              ;;
          esac
          ;;
        orchestrate)
          _arguments -C '1:action:->action' '*::arg:->rest'
          case $state in
            action) _values 'action' next report ;;
            rest)
              case ${words[1]} in
                next) _arguments '--intent[Intent text]:intent:' '--scope[Workflow scope]:scope:(solo team enterprise)' '--depth[Depth]:depth:(full standard fast)' '--mode[Orchestration mode]:mode:(human ai)' '--approved-by[Approver]:name:' '--detail[Reason]:detail:' '--force-resume[Override a failing prerequisite check]' ;;
                report)
                  _arguments \
                    '--stage[Stage identifier]:stage:' \
                    '--result[Stage result]:result:(complete blocked skipped)' \
                    '--approval[Phase approval]:approval:(approved)' \
                    '--needs[Named prerequisite that blocks the stage]:name:' \
                    '--detail[Result detail]:detail:'
                  ;;
              esac
              ;;
          esac
          ;;
        harness)
          _arguments -C '1:action:(add status refresh)' '--dry-run[Show planned changes]' '--force[Back up and replace edited files]' '1:name:(claude deepseek)'
          ;;
        config)
          _arguments -C '1:section:(agents scope mode gate-mode prerequisite)' '2:action:->action' '*::arg:->rest'
          case ${words[1]} in
            mode) _arguments '1:mode:(human ai)' ;;
            scope) _arguments '1:scope:(solo team enterprise)' ;;
            gate-mode) _arguments '1:gate:(analysis-baseline solution-direction release-candidate launch-and-handoff closure intent-closure)' '2:mode:(human default)' ;;
            prerequisite) _arguments '1:action:(set remove check)' '2:name:' '--check[Check command]:command:' '--hint[Hint shown when the check fails]:hint:' '--applies-to[Stage or phase to preflight]:stage:' ;;
          esac
          case ${words[2]} in
            set) _arguments '1:agent:(brief-analyst context-risk-analyst solution-explorer decision-facilitator implementation-planner builder-verifier release-coordinator operations-handoff outcome-curator knowledge-steward record-keeper knowledge-archivist)' '2:model:(opus sonnet haiku fable)' ;;
            reset) _arguments '1:agent:(brief-analyst context-risk-analyst solution-explorer decision-facilitator implementation-planner builder-verifier release-coordinator operations-handoff outcome-curator knowledge-steward record-keeper knowledge-archivist)' ;;
          esac
          ;;
        repos)
          _arguments -C '1:action:->action' '*::arg:->rest'
          case $state in
            action) _values 'action' add list pull remove ;;
            rest)
              case ${words[1]} in
                add) _arguments '--ref[Git ref]:ref:' '1:name:' '2:url:_urls' ;;
                pull) _arguments '--file[Dependency JSON file]:file:_files' '1:name:' ;;
                remove) _arguments '1:name:' ;;
              esac
              ;;
          esac
          ;;
        deps)
          _arguments '1:action:(add list pull)' '2:id:' '3:dependency:'
          ;;
        ids)
          _arguments '1:action:(check)' '--stage[Stage identifier]:stage:'
          ;;
        completion)
          _arguments '1:shell:(zsh)'
          ;;
      esac
      ;;
  esac
}

_dtech-aidlc "$@"
